## Travel Policy
- No travel fee within 15 km of Banashankari (includes Jayanagar, JP Nagar, Basavanagudi, Koramangala)
- Small surcharge for Whitefield, Yelahanka, Electronic City, Hebbal
- Destination wedding travel billed separately

## Deposit and Cancellation Policy
- 30% advance to lock date (refundable within 7 days of booking)
- Free reschedule once with 30 days notice
- Cancellation less than 15 days before event forfeits advance

## Response Time
- Within 2 hours during business hours (10 AM to 7 PM)
- WhatsApp replies usually under 30 minutes

## Equipment
- Professional full-frame cameras (Sony and Canon)

## FAQ (Key Questions and Answers)

Q: How do I know you will deliver high quality photos?
A: We share complete wedding and event galleries before you book. Every client receives a private online gallery within 3 weeks. Our 4.9 star rating from 150 plus clients speaks for itself. You pay only after you see the quality.

Q: What if I am not happy with the final photos?
A: Your satisfaction is guaranteed. We offer one round of free re-edits for any image you are not 100 percent happy with. If the core issue is coverage, we will discuss a partial refund or reshoot.

Q: Do you charge extra for travel within Bangalore?
A: No travel fee within 15 km of Banashankari. Beyond that, a small surcharge applies. We tell you the exact amount before you book.

Q: How much deposit do I need to pay and is it refundable?
A: 30 percent advance. Fully refundable if you cancel within 7 days of booking. After that, non-refundable but you get one free reschedule up to 30 days before your shoot.

Q: Can you handle last minute bookings?
A: Yes. We keep emergency slots for urgent events. Call directly at +91 80957 67131.

Q: What happens if my event runs late?
A: We stay. Overtime is billed at ₹2,500 per hour for events and ₹3,500 per hour for weddings.

Q: Do you sign NDAs for corporate events?
A: Yes. We sign non-disclosure agreements for product launches, internal meetings, and any sensitive corporate work.

Q: How quickly do you respond to inquiries?
A: Within 2 hours during business hours. WhatsApp replies usually under 30 minutes.

Q: What equipment do you use and do you carry backups?
A: Professional Sony and Canon full-frame cameras with dual card slots. We carry two camera bodies, four lenses, three flashes, and identical backups for everything.

Q: Which areas of Bangalore do you cover?
A: All of Bangalore – Banashankari, Indiranagar, Koramangala, Jayanagar, JP Nagar, Whitefield, Electronic City, Hebbal, Yelahanka, and beyond.

Q: What is your cancellation policy?
A: 50 percent advance confirms booking. Rescheduling allowed once with 30 days notice. Cancellations with less than 15 days notice forfeit the advance.
